heading: Retire Early? Calculate Your FIRE Corpus with This Strategy
tldr: The Financial Independence, Retire Early (FIRE) strategy focuses on aggressive savings and smart investing to achieve early retirement.
It involves significantly reducing expenses and increasing your savings rate to build a substantial investment corpus.
A common guideline is the '4% rule', which suggests you need 25 times your annual expenses as your retirement corpus.
For Indians, it's crucial to factor in inflation, rising healthcare costs, and specific tax implications when planning for FIRE.
While challenging, FIRE offers the freedom to pursue passions or a less demanding lifestyle much sooner than traditional retirement.
caption:
Imagine not having to work unless you want to, years before everyone else. That's what "FIRE" is all about! It means saving smart and living wisely so your money can work for you sooner. Our new article breaks down how much money you might need to make this dream come true, especially for us in India. Read on to see if early freedom is possible for you.
